section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports analyses on a single sample (N = 509), presenting descriptive statistics (Table 1), bivariate correlations, and hierarchical regressions predicting drive for muscularity and body appreciation. Body appreciation was described as significantly negatively correlated with Neuroticism and BMI; regressions indicated Neuroticism and BMI predicted drive for muscularity, while Neuroticism, subjective social status, BMI, and Extraversion predicted body appreciation. No labels such as 'Study 1' or multiple separate studies/subsamples are mentioned.
section_summary.evidence_source: Note. N = 509. Descriptive statistics for, and bivariate correlations between, all variables are reported in Table 1. On the other hand, body appreciation was significantly and negatively correlated with Neuroticism and BMI. We next computed two separate hierarchical regressions with drive for muscularity and body appreciation, respectively, as the criterion variables.
